purpose: Recover the published Antarctic Peninsula Landsat-7 guano classifier specification from Lynch & Schwaller (2014) Supporting Table S2 before any new-image ecological outcome is computed.

source.article: Lynch HJ, Schwaller MR (2014), PLOS ONE 9:e113301
source.reported_role: transition matrix and decision rules for the Antarctic Peninsula Landsat-7 ETM+ classifier

allowed_actions: extract plain text and tables without altering values
prohibited_actions: change the published coefficients to improve current imagery performance
next_gate: A separate sensor-harmonization recovery test must show whether the published Landsat-7 specification can be applied to Landsat Collection 2 or whether a prespecified radiometric bridge is required.
stop_rule: Failure to reproduce the published method is a measurement-method stop, not permission to tune a new classifier using demographic outcomes.
